test_title: PYST 50 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

The doctor is examining the patient.

options.text: The patient was being examined by the doctor.
The patient is examined by the doctor.
The patient is being examined by the doctor.
The patient has been examined by the doctor.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The patient is being examined by the doctor .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence provided is in the **active voice**, where the subject (doctor) performs the action of examining the patient.
 
• To transform the sentence into the **passive voice**, the focus shifts to the object of the action (patient).
 
• The structure for transforming present continuous tense sentences into passive voice is: **Object + is/are + being + past participle + by + subject.**

Correct sentence: *The patient is being examined by the doctor*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active voice:** The subject performs the action. Example: The teacher is teaching the students.
 
• **Passive voice:** The object of the action becomes the subject. Example: The students are being taught by the teacher.
 
• **Key Transformation Rules:**
 
 
• Identify the tense of the sentence.
 
• Use the correct form of the verb "to be" (is/are/was/were) based on the tense.
 
• Add "being" for present/past continuous tense.
 
• Use the past participle of the verb.
